memories_agent_path_uq.name: memories_agent_path_uq
memories_agent_path_uq.where: scope = 'agent' and archived = false and path is not null

memories_person_path_uq.name: memories_person_path_uq
memories_person_path_uq.where: scope = 'person' and archived = false and path is not null

memories_workspace_path_uq.name: memories_workspace_path_uq
memories_workspace_path_uq.where: scope = 'workspace' and archived = false and path is not null

connections_agent_connector_uq.name: connections_agent_connector_uq
connections_agent_connector_uq.where: "connections"."agent_id" is not null and "connections"."revoked_at" is null and "connections"."status" <> 'pending'

routine_executions_queued_uq.name: routine_executions_queued_uq
routine_executions_queued_uq.where: status = 'queued' and trigger is distinct from 'retry'
